blueprint.setupCue: Arch upper back, retract scapulae firmly into the bench pad, plant heels and drive through quads.
checklist: Scapulae retracted & depressed against the bench pad
Elbows tucked at a 45° angle to the torso (not flared)
Bar touches lower sternum without bouncing off the ribcage
Wrists stacked directly over elbows throughout entire press
blueprint.pitfall: Flaring elbows to 90° or bouncing bar off chest (impinges shoulders and leaks tension).

blueprint.setupCue: Set bench to 30° incline. Avoid steep 45° angles which shift tension to anterior delts.
checklist: Bench set between 15° and 30° to isolate clavicular head
Dumbbells lowered until handles reach upper chest level
1-second active stretch pause at bottom
Press up in a smooth triangle path without clinking weights
blueprint.pitfall: Setting bench too high (>45°) turning the lift into an overhead shoulder press.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 2s Controlled Descent · 1s Collarbone Touch · 1s Overhead Drive
blueprint.setupCue: Grip just outside shoulder width. Squeeze glutes and brace core to prevent lumbar hyperextension.
checklist: Glutes squeezed tight to lock pelvis into neutral
Forearms perfectly vertical under the bar at start
Pull chin back as bar clears face, then push head through
Shrug slightly at apex to safely lock out subacromial space
blueprint.pitfall: Leaning backward and turning it into an incline bench press, risking lumbar disc shear.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 3s Controlled Return · 1s Concentric Drive · 1s Flare Lockout
blueprint.setupCue: Pin elbows to the ribcage and hinge slightly forward at the hips for full tricep clearance.
checklist: Elbows pinned to sides like hinges — zero forward elbow drift
Spread the rope apart forcefully at the bottom
1-second static peak contraction at full tricep lockout
Control the eccentric return until forearms touch biceps
blueprint.pitfall: Using shoulder momentum and leaning body weight over the cable to push down.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 2s Slow Lower · 1s Top Oblique Crunch · 1s Smooth Drive
blueprint.setupCue: Hang with active shoulders (depress lats). Rotate knees diagonally toward the opposite armpit.
checklist: Engage lats to eliminate full body swing or swinging momentum
Curl pelvis upward toward ribcage (don't just lift hip flexors)
Alternate sides smoothly: left obliques then right obliques
Full dead-hang reset at the bottom of each repetition
blueprint.pitfall: Kicking legs with swinging momentum instead of curling the pelvis with the obliques.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 2s Controlled Lower · 1s Floor Deadstop · 1s Leg Drive · 1s Glute Lock
blueprint.peakTension: Full Kinetic Chain (Erectors, Hamstrings, Glutes, Lats)
blueprint.setupCue: Bar over midfoot. Bend at hips, grip bar, pull chest tall to take the slack out before lifting.
checklist: Pull the slack out of the barbell until clicking sound is heard
Squeeze lats tight like holding oranges in your armpits
Push the floor away through midfoot until bar passes knees
Lock out by driving glutes through — avoid leaning backward
blueprint.pitfall: Rounding lumbar spine off the floor or hyperextending backward at lockout.

blueprint.setupCue: Hinge hips back to a 45° torso angle. Pull elbows back toward your pockets, not the ceiling.
checklist: Torso locked rigid at 45° angle with neutral lumbar curve
Pull bar toward lower abdomen/navel, not upper chest
Retract and squeeze shoulder blades together at apex
Lower bar slowly under control to full lat stretch
blueprint.pitfall: Standing too upright or using torso jerking momentum to sling the weight up.

blueprint.setupCue: Grip 1.5x shoulder width. Lean back 10–15° and initiate the pull by driving elbows straight down.
checklist: Thighs wedged securely beneath the roller pads
Depress shoulder blades first before bending the elbows
Drive elbows down and inward toward back pockets
Full controlled overhead stretch at the top of each rep
blueprint.pitfall: Swinging torso backward like a rowing machine to move excessive stack weight.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 3s Controlled Lower · 1s Supination Drive · 1s Bicep Peak Squeeze
blueprint.setupCue: Start neutral grip, rotate wrists outward (supinate) as you pass 90° for maximal bicep head recruitment.
checklist: Elbows anchored fixed by your ribs — zero forward swing
Forcefully supinate wrist (pinky turned upward) at the top
1-second deliberate squeeze at the peak of contraction
Full tricep extension stretch at the bottom before rep starts
blueprint.pitfall: Rocking shoulders and leaning back to heave dumbbells up.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 2s Resistance Return · 1s Diagonal Contraction · 1s Rotation Drive
blueprint.setupCue: Set pulley at shoulder height. Pivot back foot and rotate through core, keeping arms extended.
checklist: Arms held extended like a pendulum — arms do not pull
Initiate power from the hips and oblique rotation
Pivot rear foot to allow hips and spine to turn naturally
Control the cable return without letting weight stack slam
blueprint.pitfall: Pulling with the arms/shoulders rather than generating torque through the oblique core wall.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 3s Scapular Stretch · 1s Face Drive · 1s External Rotation Hold
blueprint.peakTension: Rear Delts, Rhomboids, Trapezius & Rotator Cuff
blueprint.setupCue: Set cable at eye level with rope. Pull toward bridge of nose while externally rotating wrists backward.
checklist: Thumbs pointing backward at the end of the pull
Elbows high and wide throughout the movement
1-second contraction holding the 'double bicep' pose
Allow scapulae to fully protract forward on the eccentric return
blueprint.pitfall: Pulling downward into chest with internal rotation, ruining the rear delt focus.

blueprint.setupCue: Bar on upper traps/rear delts. Feet shoulder-width, toes turned 15° out. Inhale & brace 360°.
checklist: Deep 360° diaphragmatic breath & intra-abdominal brace
Break at hips and knees simultaneously
Knees track over the second toe throughout the descent
Hit parallel depth (hip crease below knee cap) with zero heel lift
blueprint.pitfall: Knees caving inward (valgus collapse) or heels elevating off the floor.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 3s Hip Hinge · 1s Hamstring Stretch · 1s Glute Thrust
blueprint.setupCue: Soft knee bend (20°), then push hips straight back to the wall. Do not squat the weight.
checklist: Slight knee bend kept fixed throughout the entire rep
Push pelvis back as far as possible until hamstrings are taut
Bar stays glued to legs (skims down thighs past knees)
Reverse direction by driving hips forward into lockout
blueprint.pitfall: Turning the hip hinge into a conventional squat or rounding the lower back.

blueprint.setupCue: Feet mid-platform. Pull handles tightly to lock pelvis firmly into the back seat pad.
checklist: Tailbone and lower back glued firmly against seat (no butt wink)
Lower sled smoothly until knees form a clean 90° angle
1-second deep pause without bouncing the sled stops
Press through midfoot — never lock out knees into hyperextension
blueprint.pitfall: Allowing lower back to peel off the pad at bottom, placing huge flexion torque on lumbar discs.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 3s Achilles Stretch · 2s Deep Deficit Hold · 1s Ball Drive · 1s Peak Squeeze
blueprint.setupCue: Knees completely straight to load Gastrocnemius. Balls of feet on step edge for full deficit.
checklist: Knees locked straight to disengage Soleus and isolate Gastrocnemius
Sink heels into a deep deficit and hold a strict 2s stretch
Explode onto the balls of your big toes, not the outside edge
Hold peak contraction for 1 second before lowering
blueprint.pitfall: Bouncing fast on the Achilles tendon spring instead of making calf muscles do the work.

blueprint.tempoDesc: 2s Controlled Drop · 1s Hinge Reset · 1s Drive · 2s Glute Squeeze
blueprint.setupCue: Bench pivot right beneath shoulder blades. Shins vertical (90° knee angle) at apex.
checklist: Bench edge positioned directly below inferior angle of scapulae
Vertical shins at top of rep (if feet too far: hamstrings; if too close: quads)
Drive through heels into full posterior pelvic tilt
Maintain chin tucked & eyes forward to safeguard lumbar spine
blueprint.pitfall: Looking up at ceiling and hyperextending lower back instead of squeezing glutes.
